generation_method: ulp --docs (runtime-reflected configuration roots; generated output must not be edited)

parameters.name: AppDataFolder
parameters.description: Folder where program writes log files, backups and other application data. By default this folder is located in My Documents

parameters.name: ChangeTextSizeInPercent
parameters.description: Increase or decrease the default text size (in percent).

parameters.name: DefaultDashboardLimit
parameters.description: Rows limit when loading the default dashboard from Windows Event Log tree.

parameters.name: DefaultEvtProperties
parameters.description: Default settings for reading Windows Event logs (-i:EVT input type).

parameters.name: AdvancedEventLogQuery
parameters.description: Advanced XML query for Windows Event Log filtering (see Microsoft documentation). Intended for special cases; leave empty to read all events.

parameters.name: AskForUserCredentials
parameters.description: When to prompt for domain, username, and password when connecting to remote computers. If set to Never (or if credentials are not provided), current user credentials are used. Values: OnlyForRemoteComputers, Never, Always.

parameters.name: Computers
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of computer names to read Windows Event Logs from. Use an empty string or '.' for the local computer. Remote access permissions are required.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used for parsing and formatting values. If empty, the current thread culture is used (for example, en-US).

parameters.name: FormatMsg
parameters.description: If True, normalizes whitespace in the Message field (collapses multiple whitespace characters to a single space) for improved readability.

parameters.name: IgnoreErrors
parameters.description: If True, ignores non-fatal errors while reading event records. If False, errors are thrown and reading stops.

parameters.name: IncludeEventXml
parameters.description: If True, includes the full event XML (EventXml) for each record. Warning: may significantly reduce performance.

parameters.name: IncludeMessage
parameters.description: Controls whether to include the formatted Message field. Messages are resolved from external resources and can significantly reduce performance, especially when reading remotely. Values: Always, OnlyErrors, OnlyErrorsAndWarnings, Never.

parameters.name: IncludeMessageFromRemoteComputer
parameters.description: Controls whether to include the formatted Message field when reading from a remote computer. Messages are resolved from external resources and can significantly reduce performance. Values: Always, OnlyErrors, OnlyErrorsAndWarnings, Never.

parameters.name: IncludeStrings
parameters.description: If True, populates the Strings field from event properties. Warning: may significantly reduce performance on large datasets.

parameters.name: Recurse
parameters.description: Maximum number of subdirectory recursion levels when loading EVTX files from disk (for example, 'C:\Logs\*.evtx'). 0 disables recursion; -1 enables unlimited recursion.

parameters.name: ResolveUserSIDs
parameters.description: Resolve user SIDs to account names in an additional field. Warning: may significantly reduce performance on large datasets.

parameters.name: ReverseDirection
parameters.description: If True, reads events in reverse order (newest events first).

parameters.name: StringsSeparator
parameters.description: Separator used when joining multi-value fields (for example, event property values and keyword display names). Default is '|'.

parameters.name: CheckpointCompleteLinesOnly
parameters.description: When enabled, an incremental read stops after the last complete line. An unfinished trailing line is kept for the next successful read. This is intended for tail-style polling of growing text files.

parameters.name: CheckpointFile
parameters.description: Optional checkpoint file for incremental input. The first successful query reads all records; later successful queries using the same source and checkpoint read only appended records. A filename without a directory is stored in the system temporary directory. Failed or cancelled queries never advance the checkpoint.

parameters.name: CheckpointStartAtEnd
parameters.description: When enabled and no checkpoint exists yet, begin after the current input instead of reading its existing records. Later reads return appended records. This is useful for tail-style monitoring.

parameters.name: ExtendedFields
parameters.description: Include extended fields such as file path, line number, record number, etc.

parameters.name: ErrorsToIgonre
parameters.description: Maximum number of errors allowed. 0 does not ignore errors; -1 ignores all read errors.

parameters.name: IgnoreConvertExceptions
parameters.description: Ignore conversion exceptions and return null. Otherwise, string fields will contain the error message for troubleshooting.

parameters.name: DefaultLimit
parameters.description: Default rows limit when query is run for the first time.

parameters.name: DefaultUserFilesFolder
parameters.description: Folder where data files are located. By default this folder is located in My Documents or is LPL installation folder (depending on your installation)

parameters.name: DownloadEvtxECmdMapsOnStart
parameters.description: Download EvtxECmd maps from the GitHub repository on program start.

parameters.name: EnableCodeCompletionInTextEditor
parameters.display_name: Enable Code Completion in the Editor
parameters.description: Enable code completion in the editor for supported languages (e.g., SQL, VB.NET, C#).

parameters.name: EvtxECmdMapsFolder
parameters.description: Folder where the program will look for map files for the EVtxECmd data provider.

parameters.name: HighlightWarningsAndErrors
parameters.description: Highlight Errors, Warnings and Critical events for Windows EVT and EvtxECmd format.

parameters.name: LoadEmptyWindowsEvents
parameters.display_name: Load empty system logs in the EVT tree
parameters.description: If FALSE only logs that has rows will be loaded in the Windows Events tree

parameters.name: UseVbNetScript
parameters.description: Allows inline VB.NET code to be executed in the query. The inline VB.NET is between <% and %>

parameters.name: Distinct
parameters.description: Indicates whether to select distinct rows. Default is false.

parameters.name: FilterDate
parameters.description: Filter by date range for the query. Default is NoFilter. Values: NoFilter, Last30Minutes, LastHour, Last6Hours, Last24Hours, Last7Days, Last30Days, Last365Days, Today, ThisWeek, LastWeek, ThisMonth, LastMonth, ThisQuarter, PreviousQuarter, ThisYear.

parameters.name: FilterLevel
parameters.description: Filter level for the query (e.g., Information, Warning, Error). Default is NoFilter. Values: NoFilter, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, Verbose, LogAlways.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Table or source to query from. Default is 'default_table'.

parameters.name: GroupBy
parameters.description: Group by clause for the query.

parameters.name: Having
parameters.description: Having clause for the query.

parameters.name: HttpStatusCodeFilter
parameters.description: Filter logs by HTTP status codes (e.g., Success, UserErrors, ServerError). Default is NoFilter. Values: NoFilter, Informational, Success, Redirection, ClientError, ServerError.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of rows returned. Default is 100.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset for the query results.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description: Order by clause for the query.

parameters.name: Select
parameters.description: Columns to select in the query. Default is '*'.

parameters.name: Where
parameters.description: Filter condition for the query.

parameters.name: AllowInlineVbNetScripts
parameters.description: Allow trusted inline VB.NET blocks in SQL preprocessing. Disabled is the safer default for untrusted queries.

parameters.name: Constants
parameters.description: Named SQL preprocessing constants. Prefer bound SQL parameters for data values.

parameters.name: QueryProperties
parameters.description: Command-style query properties made available while preprocessing a query script.

parameters.name: VbArguments
parameters.description: Named values made available to trusted inline VB.NET query blocks.

parameters.name: ContinueOnError
parameters.description: Continue with later query blocks after a block fails.

parameters.name: IncludeErrorTables
parameters.description: Add structured error tables to the combined result when query blocks fail.
